observations: segmented cells with a transferred cell type; counts are summed spot UMIs

coordinates.units: registered Stereo-seq spot units (500 nm), centroid of the cell's spots
coordinates.raw: x, y are the unregistered chip coordinates

region_assignment: gene_area code with the largest UMI share in the cell; 0 = background

ranks.direction: ascending: larger rank means higher expression
ranks.zeros: all unstored genes have rank zero_rank2 / 2; stored ranks are absolute
ranks.universe: current MGI protein-coding genes detected in at least min_cells typed cells of the processed slices

pseudobulk.description: per slice and annotation level: summed retained-gene UMIs per (label, gene), <level>_counts rows follow <level>_index into labels[level]; <level>_cells counts cells
